name: Smithy
description: An example package with one of everything: a blacksmith role, a smithing skill, an anvil you can strike, and a little code (the smith hammers between customers; the bellows).
author: Tablefolk

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.description: Forge iron bars into useful things at an anvil.
smithing.prompt: You are a smith: you can forge {{recipes}} from an iron bar.

forge.help: make something from an iron bar

nails.text: {{me}} hammers an iron bar into nails

horseshoe.text: {{me}} bends a glowing bar into a horseshoe

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: Works the forge: makes and sells iron goods.
blacksmith.duty: You are the village smith. Sell your iron goods with sell(item, price), and forge more with forge(thing) when you run low or a customer asks for something.
